content: Vulkan offscreen render pass attachment ops: VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR gives deterministic initialization to a specified clear value; VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE leaves contents undefined and is non-deterministic -- must never be used on hashed regions. STORE_OP_STORE required to persist rendered contents for later readback (STORE_OP_DONT_CARE leaves framebuffer undefined after rendering). Render pass attachment description's finalLayout auto-transitions the image at render-pass end; for a color attachment destined for vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer, finalLayout should be VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL (or a subsequent explicit vkCmdPipelineBarrier layout transition performed before the copy if finalLayout was left as COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL).
